dedupe_keys.name: recycling and waste facilities in scotland

description: This layer compiles council recycling and waste management facilities in Scotland into one consistent national dataset, held as points for recycling places, which include bins and centres, and for waste management sites. The Improvement Service, which runs Spatial Hub Scotland, maintains it, and the record says it is checked for geometry validity and duplicates. The metadata gives a reference date of 1 May 2026 and updates as needed. Coverage is Scotland at facility level. Access is through OGC Web Feature Service and Web Map Service endpoints listed in the Spatial Hub catalogue, free of charge under the Open Government Licence version 3. Caveats: the layer holds locations and types, not tonnages or capacity, council contributions may differ in completeness and no download file was listed on the record read. It suits capacity planning and emergency response studies of waste and recycling services, and exposure analysis of sites to flooding. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
